notes.title: Update 01 - August '23
notes.content: So here we have the first update for Abandonware and things are getting weirder ... again, thank you to everyone for all of your help in deciphering what the hell we've found here. We've noticed a few new things appearing and as always are reaching out to the community to see what we can discover ...

notes.title: Abandonware is available for PC, Mac and Linux
notes.content:
Abandonware is a strange story and it just keeps getting weirder and weirder ... earlier this year we discovered a 3.5" Internal Hard Drive next to a stream in the woods where we walk the dogs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256414/1e36d19cc2e305d80e0849f8674a4ffd524ae080.png[/img]

After cleaning it up as best as we could and leaving it in rice for a few days we plugged it in and what we discovered was ... well .. concerning. So we're turning to the Steam Community to help us uncover exactly what we've found ...

Abandonware launches today with Streamer keys available from [url=https://twitter.com/pr_hound]PR Hound[/url] and [url=https://woovit.com/]Woovit[/url]. Thank you for giving this a spin, and if you find anything ... please post it everywhere so we can get to the bottom of what's going on!
